name: CRM Agent — CX Intelligence
desc: Agentic AI system that monitors CX data (tickets, reviews, NPS), detects anomalies, investigates root cause, and produces alerts and actions. FastAPI + LangGraph + ChromaDB + React.

name: ATLAS-X — Fraud Detection with Graph Features
desc: Team project: XGBoost with graph features from a Neo4j card–device–email network, trained on 590k real IEEE-CIS transactions (0.957 AUC, ~17 ms inference), with Kafka streaming, FastAPI, Prometheus/Grafana monitoring and LLM-generated explanations.

name: Citation-Aware Multimodal Research Analysis
desc: Research assistant for PDFs that runs a local Llama 3.1 8B with FAISS retrieval, parses tables and flowcharts, maps citations, and answers questions with sources through a Streamlit interface.

name: Explainable AI Demos
desc: Jupyter notebook collection demonstrating various XAI techniques and methodologies for model interpretability and transparency in machine learning applications.

name: EchoShield
desc: Real-time, on-device audio system for voice isolation and smart ambient-mode triggers, using WebRTC VAD, Resemblyzer speaker verification and Vosk wake-word detection. Tuned frame size from 30 to 60 ms to fix CPU overload.

name: Life Copilot
desc: Created an AI-powered personal assistant that automates daily tasks, provides decision support, and streamlines life management.

name: AR E-Brochure Vedic Heritage
desc: Developed an interactive AR e-brochure showcasing Vedic heritage, combining cultural storytelling with modern web and augmented reality technologies.
